settings.question: What steel grade are Lawnix tools made from?
settings.answer: All Lawnix products use 304-grade stainless steel — the same spec used in commercial kitchen and medical equipment. It resists rust, corrosion, and bending under heavy loads, season after season.

settings.question: What does the 5-year warranty cover?
settings.answer: Everything. If any Lawnix product fails due to manufacturing defects or normal use within 5 years, we'll replace it — no paperwork, no questions, no hassle. Just contact us and we'll sort it.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — free standard shipping on every order, every time. No minimum, no exceptions. We also offer expedited options at checkout if you need it faster.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: 30-day hassle-free returns. If you're not 100% satisfied for any reason, return the product within 30 days for a full refund. We cover return shipping on defective items.

settings.question: How long does assembly take?
settings.answer: Under 2 minutes — tool-free. The LX-30 and all Lawnix tools are designed for instant setup. Everything snaps and locks securely with no tools required.

settings.question: Are Lawnix tools suitable for commercial use?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Many professional landscapers and lawn care crews use Lawnix tools daily. The build quality is designed for heavy commercial use — multiple uses per day, every day.
